items.followUp: Name two conditions that can cause an enzyme to denature.

rubric.why: Denaturation involves a change in the enzyme’s structure.
rubric.description: Identifies a structural change in the enzyme.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the enzyme’s structure changes.

rubric.why: The altered active site prevents the enzyme from functioning properly.
rubric.description: States the effect of denaturation on the active site and enzyme activity.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the active site is altered and the enzyme becomes inactive.

modelAnswer: Denaturation is a change in an enzyme’s structure that alters its active site.
The enzyme then becomes inactive and cannot function properly.
